desc: Derive key insight: cost = S - N*H for any feasible H, so maximize feasible H
Derive O(N) feasibility check via greatest element (forward-backward pass, no heaps)
Prove monotonicity of feasibility in H enabling binary search
Implement `feasible(H)`: R_i = min(U_i, H); forward g_i = min(R_i, g_{i-1}+X); backward g_i = min(g_i, g_{i+1}+X); check g_i + D_i >= H; return bool
Binary search largest feasible integer H in [0, 2*10^9] with invariant lo feasible
Compute answer = sum(U_i+D_i) - N*H* and print (Python int handles large values)
Verify against samples: sample1 H*=4 cost 15; sample2 H*=6 cost 0; sample3 H*=2 cost 5999999994; sample4 cost 9460
Confirm edge cases and performance: H=0 always feasible, hi=2e9 sufficient, ~31 probes × O(N) runs in time in Python
